purpose: Three-seed replication of the corrected Peptides-struct training pipeline
selection: best validation MAE for each completed run
invariants: Reuse the exact source and runner hashes from the reference study
Verify identical topology, targets and cached spectra across studies
Keep architecture, optimizer, frequency labels and spectral settings fixed
Report all planned results, including negative outcomes; no early stopping by score

comparisons.hypothesis: performance against public SignNet source port

reporting: Mean and sample standard deviation, all paired differences, direction counts; three seeds are screening evidence, not a converged benchmark
decision: Consistent benefits justify longer training; inconsistent or negative differences do not justify new spectral modules. Do not declare H1 or H2 established from this short screen.
